'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Gaza war hostage crisis]]
***[[Hamas]] announces that it is postponing the return of the body of a dead [[hostage]], citing multiple violations of the ceasefire by [[Israel]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/hamas-armed-wing-will-postpone-tuesdays-handover-dead-hostages-body-cites-2025-10-28/ (Reuters)]
**[[Israeli incursions in the West Bank during the Gaza war]]
***Three [[Al-Qassam Brigades]] militants are killed by [[IDF|Israeli troops]] in a shooting–[[airstrike]] attack in Kfar Qud, near [[Jenin]], in the occupied [[West Bank]]. [https://today.lorientlejour.com/article/1482763/israel-police-say-3-palestinians-killed-in-raid-near-jenin.html (''L'Orient Today'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-forces-kill-three-palestinian-militants-west-bank-police-say-2025-10-28/ (Reuters)]
**[[Hamas]] fires at and launches an [[anti-tank missile]] at Israeli troops in [[Rafah]], [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]], killing an Israeli soldier. [https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-871941 (''The Jerusalem Post'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cgjdy5eevn2o (BBC)]
**At least 104 people are killed, including 46 children, and 50 others are injured in multiple Israeli retaliatory airstrikes across [[Gaza City]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/10/28/israel-says-return-of-misidentified-body-breaches-gaza-deal-mulls-response (Al Jazeera)]  [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/trump-says-gaza-ceasefire-holds-israel-has-right-hit-back-if-attacked-2025-10-29/ (Reuters)]
*[[Armed conflict for control of the favelas]]
**[[Operation Containment]]
***Sixty-four people, including four [[Law enforcement in Brazil|police officers]], are killed in large-scale raids on [[Comando Vermelho]] spots in [[Rio de Janeiro]], [[Brazil]], making it the deadliest police operation in the city's history. At least 81 suspected gang members are arrested in the operation. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/10/28/americas/brazil-police-raid-rio-de-janeiro-latam-intl (CNN)] [https://www.dw.com/en/brazil-20-dead-including-police-in-major-rio-drugs-raid/a-74530642 (DW)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Al-Fashir massacre]]
***Over 460 people are killed in an attack on a hospital by the [[Rapid Support Forces]] in [[Al-Fashir]], [[North Darfur]], Sudan. [https://apnews.com/article/sudan-hospital-rsf-darfur-fasher-who-3ac305299da5ee388429f3352ca5c6fa (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[AI boom]], [[Workplace impact of artificial intelligence]]
**Multinational technology and [[e-commerce]] company [[Amazon Inc|Amazon]] announces it will [[layoff|lay off]] 14,000 corporate positions as it invests more in building [[artificial intelligence|AI]] and [[cloud computing]] infrastructure. [https://www.dw.com/en/amazon-to-cut-14000-corporate-jobs-amid-ai-investment/a-74524365 (DW)] [https://www.cnbc.com/2025/10/28/amazon-layoffs-corporate-workers-ai.html (CNBC)]
*[[Economy of the Philippines]]
**The [[Philippine peso]] falls to a record low of ₱59.2 per [[U.S. dollar]], which [[Philippines|the country]]'s [[Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas|central bank]] attributes to [[currency depreciation]] influenced by recent [[interest rate]] cuts and foreign investment outflows. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-10-28/php-usd-philippine-peso-flirts-with-record-low-on-rate-cut-view-stock-outflow (Bloomberg)]

'''Disasters and accidents '''
*[[2025 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Melissa]] makes landfall in [[Westmoreland Parish|Westmoreland parish]], southwest [[Jamaica]], as a [[Saffir-Simpson scale|Category 5]] hurricane with 185 mph sustained winds. [https://www.cnn.com/weather/live-news/hurricane-melissa-jamaica-landfall-tuesday-climate?t=1761671017139 (CNN)] [https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/archive/2025/al13/al132025.update.10281700.shtml (NHC)]
*[[Mombasa Air Safari Flight 203]]
**A [[Mombasa Air Safari]]-operated [[Cessna 208 Caravan]] aircraft carrying foreign tourists from [[Hungary]] and [[Germany]] crashes near [[Kwale]], [[Kenya]], killing all 11 people on board. [https://apnews.com/article/kenya-plane-crash-kwale-tourism-maasai-mara-20f6c5fa0a77a70af475844d0d42bd18 (AP)]
*Eighteen people are killed when a wooden vessel carrying dozens of irregular refugees capsizes off the coast of [[Surman, Libya|Surman]], [[Libya]]. [https://www.trtworld.com/article/c30d01c05303 (TRT World)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2020–2025 H5N1 outbreak]]
**The [[German government]] culls 500,000 birds, including chickens, geese, and turkeys, as the [[Friedrich Loeffler Institute|federal animal health institute]] reports over 100 outbreaks of [[Influenza A virus subtype H5N1|H5N1]] [[avian influenza]], including 30 outbreaks among [[poultry]] [[battery cage|battery farms]] across the country. [https://www.dw.com/en/germany-500000-birds-culled-as-flu-spreads/a-74516613 (DW)]

'''International relations'''
*[[China]] and the [[Association of Southeast Asian Nations]] (ASEAN) sign an upgraded [[free trade agreement]], which will broaden collaboration on infrastructure, digital and green transition, trade facilitation and people-to-people exchanges between the two sides, on the sidelines of the [[2025 ASEAN Summits|47th ASEAN summit]] in [[Kuala Lumpur]], [[Malaysia]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/asean-china-free-trade-agreement-5428731 (CNA)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Assassination of Shinzo Abe]]
**The trial of [[Tetsuya Yamagami]], the alleged killer of former [[Japan]]ese [[Japanese Prime Minister|prime minister]] [[Shinzo Abe]], opens in [[Nara (city)|Nara]]. It is expected to end by mid-December. [https://apnews.com/article/trial-former-japanese-prime-minister-abe-japan-0c9af312a2bd651712731167960d8f3a (AP)]
*[[Crime in London]]
**One person is killed and two others, including a 14-year-old, are injured in a [[mass stabbing]] in [[London]], [[England]]. A 22-year-old [[Afghans in the United Kingdom|Afghan national]] is arrested. [https://news.sky.com/story/man-dies-after-three-people-stabbed-in-london-13459217 (Sky News)]
*[[Fiji]]an deputy [[Prime Minister of Fiji|prime minister]] [[Biman Prasad]] says that he intends to resign after being charged with [[corruption]]. He is the second deputy PM in [[Sitiveni Rabuka]]'s government to be charged since last week. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/577048/second-fijian-deputy-pm-charged-with-corruption-related-offences (RNZ)]
*[[Nigeria]]'s [[Senate of Nigeria|Senate]] passes the Endangered Species Conservation and Protection Bill, introducing fines of up to [[Nigerian naira|₦]]12 million ([[United States dollar|US$]]8,250) and prison sentences of up to 10 years for [[wildlife smuggling]] and strengthening enforcement against illegal [[Ivory trade|trade in ivory]], [[Pangolin trade|pangolin scales]], and other endangered species. [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/nigeria-impose-more-stringent-penalties-wildlife-traffickers-2025-10-29/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Conscription in Russia]]
**The [[Russia]]n [[State Duma]] approves a bill to change [[military conscription]] to a year-round process, passing it to the [[Federation Council (Russia)|Federation Council]] for approval. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-military-conscription-draft-ukraine-war-9849511e45f7b7db596103fd71e69bae (AP)]

**The [[Turkish Football Federation]] takes disciplinary action against 152 [[referee]]s who were found to have actively [[sports betting|placed bets]] on football matches.
